title: server: implement validate_hole_punching
description: Implement server function to validate hole punching patterns in requirement specifications. Hole punching identifies gaps in coverage where edge cases or error conditions are not properly addressed.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL scan all requirements for coverage gaps
THE SYSTEM SHALL report identified holes with severity classification

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a complete requirement specification is submitted
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL execute hole punching analysis across all defined scenarios

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a coverage hole is identified
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL generate a hole report with suggested patches

unwanted.condition: IF critical edge cases are not covered
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT mark the requirement as complete
unwanted.because: uncovered edge cases lead to production failures

unwanted.condition: IF error handling paths are undefined
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT approve the specification
unwanted.because: undefined error handling creates system vulnerabilities

preconditions: Requirement must have defined scope boundaries
Known edge case catalog must be loaded
Error taxonomy must be available for reference
postconditions: Hole report lists all identified coverage gaps
Each hole includes affected requirement section
Each hole includes recommended remediation approach
invariants: Hole detection shall be exhaustive within defined scope
Detection shall not produce false negatives for cataloged patterns
Report format shall be consistent across all analyses

happy: Given a requirement with comprehensive coverage, when validate_hole_punching is called, then no holes are reported and validation passes
Given a requirement missing error handling, when validate_hole_punching is called, then the specific hole is identified with location
Given a requirement with implicit edge cases, when validate_hole_punching is called, then implicit gaps are surfaced as potential holes
error: Given a requirement with undefined scope, when validate_hole_punching is called, then validation returns UNDEFINED_SCOPE error
Given a requirement where analysis exceeds timeout, when validate_hole_punching is called, then validation returns ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT error with partial results
Given an unloaded edge case catalog, when validate_hole_punching is called, then validation returns CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE error
